d: The Scalper layout in Kite's Terminal Mode combines your chart, option chain, and order window into a single workspace for faster options trading. You can monitor live P&L and funds, track price movements on the ticker bar, and view linked charts that automatically update when you change the underlying asset. Execute orders instantly through the quick order window or option chain, manage active positions, and customise your screen with calculators and open interest widgets to streamline your scalping workflow.
